## Workload

Lena Fischer completed 777 reads during 354 hours of grading work. This represents an average of 2.2 reads per hour. The workload was recorded across the review period and provides a clear measure of activity and throughput. The recorded hours and reads indicate a consistent level of grading activity, with the average rate reported for monitoring purposes.

## Quality

A total of 63 reads were checked again as part of the quality review. Agreement was recorded at 57.1 per cent. The review included feedback on borderline background cases, supporting attention to consistency and judgement in more difficult assessments. The findings provide a basis for further review of grading decisions and for maintaining consistent standards.

The work was reviewed by Priya Anand.
